description.value: Mr. Shawarma claims to be the first Middle Eastern and shawarma food truck in Canada, serving downtown Vancouver since 2009 from multiple street-level locations including Robson Square and two SkyTrain station entrances. All food is prepared fresh daily from scratch using halal-certified, locally sourced BC ingredients out of their own 8,000 sq ft commercial kitchen.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: stands (6 spaces) at 73m; stands (2 spaces) at 84m. Total: 8 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Mr. Shawarma is a multi-location shawarma food truck chain operating since 2009, with the main address at 800 Robson Street and additional street-level locations near Burrard and Granville SkyTrain entrances and at West Georgia & Thurlow. Takeout is explicitly the core service model ('Take Out & Meals-On-The-Go'), and falafel items on the menu confirm vegetarian/vegan options. No bike parking, water refill, or washroom information appears anywhere on the website, leaving all required WWC criteria unverifiable.
concerns: OSM fixme='Food truck' tag flags the record as incomplete; single OSM point at ~49.283, -123.117 represents only one of multiple operating locations.
Website name is 'Mr.Shawarma' (with period); OSM uses 'Mr Shawarma' (without period) — minor discrepancy.
No address or phone in OSM; both values sourced from website contact page and unverifiable against OSM.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active, legitimate food business at high-traffic downtown Vancouver cycling locations, but none of the required WWC criteria (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) can be confirmed from available evidence; on-site verification recommended.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Falafel items described as freshly made from ground chickpeas, fresh herbs, and vegetables — vegetarian and vegan. No gluten-free options mentioned
